origin.description: Replace the first literal match in each string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: Text that replaces each match. NA makes a matched string missing.

origin.details: str, pattern, and replacement are recycled together. Text outside the match is kept. No match returns the original string, even when replacement is NA. An empty string stays empty. An empty pattern or a missing string or pattern yields NA. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
origin.example:
found <- stri_replace_first_fixed("aAaA", "a", "X", case_insensitive = TRUE)
cat(paste0('stri_replace_first_fixed("aAaA", "a", "X", case_insensitive=TRUE) returns ', found, '.\n'))

translation.description: Replace the first literal match in each string.
translation.usage: stri_replace_first_fixed(str, pattern, replacement, opts_fixed=None, case_insensitive=None, overlap=None)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Literal pattern, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: Text that replaces each match. NA makes a matched string missing.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: None, or a dict of search settings. Overlap is ignored.

arguments.name: case_insensitive
arguments.text: If given, match the simple uppercase of each code point.

arguments.name: overlap
arguments.text: Ignored, as in the installed function.

translation.details: str, pattern, and replacement are recycled together. Text outside the match is kept. No match returns the original string, even when replacement is NA. An empty string stays empty. An empty pattern or a missing string or pattern yields NA. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
translation.value: A list of strings and NA.
translation.example:
from stringi.fixed import stri_replace_first_fixed
found = stri_replace_first_fixed("aAaA", "a", "X", case_insensitive=True)
print(f'stri_replace_first_fixed("aAaA", "a", "X", case_insensitive=True) returns {found[0]}.')
